description_en: Queries the car service billing data generated by a specified enterprise within a specific time period
description_zh: 通过调用本接口可实现查询指定企业在特定时间段产生的用车账单数据
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen ie-car-bill-settlement-query --period-start 2021-10-01 --period-end 2021-10-02 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --bill-batch 20250725 --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token feth00jqwls --scroll-mod true --scroll-id CAESBgoEIgIIABgAIhkKFwMSAAAAMUw4MDAwMDAwMDA3MzA1MGJj --order-id 1002002203361199686 --bill-record-time-start 2025-01-01 --bill-record-time-end 2025-01-02 --apply-id example-string --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IeCarBillSettlementQuery

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

This is a required header parameter for HTTP calls. For information about how to obtain it, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
You can use `corp_token=value` in the request URL as an alternative

可以在请求地址中使用 `corp_token=value` 替代
